scope: Independent data identity audit before any fresh detector/SGG training; never test performance tuning
fingerprint_method: Existing pinned raw RGB/no EXIF normalized DCT32 low8 median excluding DC phash63, four rotations; no journal or method edits

candidate_rule.proof_scope: Complete retrieval for radius<=4 on available fingerprints; not complete detection of visual duplicates

exclusion_policy.exact_jpeg_or_raw_rgb: Exclude every source VG TRAIN/VAL identity matching a protected held-out identity
exclusion_policy.near_candidates: Conservatively exclude every source VG TRAIN/VAL identity within registered radius of a protected identity, regardless of whether later visual review calls it the same photograph
exclusion_policy.direction: VG TRAIN to VG VAL/TEST; VG VAL to VG TEST; VG TRAIN/VAL to external VAL/TEST
exclusion_policy.evaluation_membership: Protected held-out IDs and failed/missing IDs stay in their original evaluation denominators
exclusion_policy.false_positive_tradeoff: Candidate exclusion may discard unrelated training images; candidate similarity alone is not proof of duplicate identity
exclusion_policy.old_manifest: Preserve provisional draft and all live benchmark weights; final release is a new immutable version

preparation_status: POLICY_AND_RETRIEVAL_ONLY; no candidate journal launched or final training manifest generated
